headerDisplay: **Homebridge Yoto Plugin** - Control your Yoto players through HomeKit
footerDisplay: For help and documentation, visit the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/mdjhnson/homebridge-yoto)

clientId.title: OAuth Client ID
clientId.description: OAuth client ID for Yoto API authentication. The default works for most users. Only change if you've created your own OAuth app at yoto.dev.

accessToken.title: Access Token
accessToken.description: Automatically managed by the authentication flow. Do not edit manually.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Automatically managed by the authentication flow. Do not edit manually.

tokenExpiresAt.title: Token Expiration
tokenExpiresAt.description: Automatically managed by the authentication flow. Do not edit manually.

httpPollIntervalMs.title: HTTP Poll Interval (ms)
httpPollIntervalMs.description: How often to poll the Yoto API for device status and config as a fallback to MQTT updates. Defaults to 60000 (1 minute).

playbackControls.title: Playback Controls
playbackControls.description: Add a play/pause switch and a volume dimmer to each player. Simplest option, with no extra pairing.

smartSpeaker.title: External Smart Speaker (Legacy)
smartSpeaker.description: Legacy option kept for existing setups. Publishes a separate Smart Speaker accessory that only works in Home app scenes and automations. Requires pairing and its own network port.

television.title: TV Playback Accessory
television.description: Publish an external TV-style accessory: play/pause and volume from the iPhone remote, and inputs that play your cards, card controls and shortcuts. Requires pairing and its own network port.

televisionLibrary.title: TV Inputs for Library Cards
televisionLibrary.description: Add every card in your Yoto library as a TV input, listed alphabetically. HomeKit allows about 90 inputs; if your library is bigger, cards past the limit are left out.

nightlight.title: Nightlight
nightlight.description: Expose day/night nightlight controls and status.

cardControls.title: Card Controls
cardControls.description: Add switches that play a specific card ID on each Yoto device. Optionally add an accessory that plays the card on all Yotos.

label.title: Label
label.description: Name shown in HomeKit for this card control.

cardId.title: Card ID
cardId.description: The Yoto card ID to play.

playOnAll.title: Play on All Yotos
playOnAll.description: Create a separate accessory that plays this card on every Yoto.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Expose a switch for each shortcut configured on the Yoto (in the Yoto app under the player's shortcut buttons). Turning a switch on plays that shortcut.

sleepTimer.title: Sleep Timer
sleepTimer.description: Expose the sleep timer as a slider. Each 1% is one minute unless changed below; turning it on without a time uses 30 minutes.

sleepTimerMinutesPerPercent.title: Sleep Timer Minutes per 1%
sleepTimerMinutesPerPercent.description: How many minutes each 1% on the sleep timer slider adds. 1 gives up to 100 minutes; 2 gives up to 200 minutes.

items.helpvalue: Sign in and out from the Yoto panel above. The default OAuth Client ID works for all users. The token fields below are managed by the plugin and should not be edited by hand.
Select which HomeKit services to expose for each Yoto device.
The older External Smart Speaker option has moved to the Advanced section below.
Card Controls: Add switches that play a specific card ID on each Yoto. Enable "Play on All Yotos" to create a separate accessory.

Legacy: External Smart Speaker. Older playback option kept for existing setups. It only works in scenes and automations. The Home app shows "Controls not available" for it and can't show what's playing, because iOS only offers those for AirPlay speakers. For more features, turn on the TV Playback Accessory under Accessory Services instead. It supports the iPhone remote, volume buttons, and inputs for card controls and shortcuts. If you switch, remove the old Smart Speaker from the Home app by hand.
